title: How language model agents reshape price competition
abstract: arXiv:2610.21711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Repeated Bertrand competition is a stringent benchmark for algorithmic pricing: in homogeneous-goods markets, standard learning procedures typically select the stage-game Nash outcome with prices near marginal cost. We show that LLM pricing agents can escape this benchmark, depending on deployment decisions. LLMs outperform standard online learners through faster adaptation, but this advantage largely disappears against full-information learners. An extracted surrogate algorithm illustrates how LLMs in specific deployments profit from regularly undercutting slower learners. Agents that post one price every period from raw market histories that include rival prices can sustain supracompetitive regimes in self-play. Agents that periodically emit probability distributions from summarized histories of their own profits instead move toward the competitive region in self-play. translated_title: 语言模型智能体如何重塑价格竞争
translated_abstract: 重复伯特兰竞争是算法定价的一个严苛基准：在同质商品市场中，标准学习程序通常收敛到阶段博弈的纳什结果，即价格接近边际成本。我们证明，大语言模型（LLM）定价智能体能够突破这一基准，而这取决于其部署方式的选择。LLM凭借更快的适应能力优于标准在线学习器，但在面对全信息学习器时，这一优势基本消失。通过提取替代算法，我们揭示了特定部署方式下的LLM如何通过定期压低价格、抢占较慢学习器而获利。每一期从包含对手价格的原始市场历史中直接发布单一价格的智能体，在自我对弈中能够维持超竞争（高于竞争水平）的定价状态；而定期从自身利润的摘要历史中输出概率分布的智能体，则在自我对弈中趋向竞争性区域。混合这两种接口的市场则可能产生动态的价格状态。
tldr: 大语言模型定价智能体能够突破标准学习算法难以摆脱的伯特兰竞争“边际成本定价”基准，且其行为关键取决于部署接口——直接从原始市场历史发布价格的智能体可在自我对弈中维持超竞争高价，而从自身利润摘要中输出概率分布的智能体则趋向竞争性定价。
en_tdlr: LLM pricing agents can escape the Bertrand benchmark of near-marginal-cost pricing that standard learners typically converge to, with deployment decisions playing a critical role: agents posting prices from raw market histories sustain supracompetitive regimes in self-play, while agents emitting probability distributions from summarized profit histories move toward competitive outcomes.
